Protected resident page redirects anonymous visitors to login.
Signup validates inputs, updates password rules, saves one resident and signs them in.
Login survives refresh; the session cookie is HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax.
Resident is blocked from administrator pages and API actions.
Logout invalidates the old session and protected pages remain unavailable afterward.
Wrong credentials show a safe error, clear the password and preserve the email; a valid login succeeds.
Duplicate signup is rejected even when email capitalization changes.
Administrators log in to their protected dashboard, survive refresh and cannot use resident-only APIs. External return URLs are ignored.
